title: 第23章 暴躁的楚师兄第24章 梦想 成为星河师兄那样优秀的人
slug: 我只想毁灭宗门咋逆天成神了
lines: 马良其实一直都不太喜欢楚星河。
大家都是同一天进的山门，楚星河凭什么被各种夸赞被捧在最高处？
在马良看来，楚星河那一切都是运气罢了。
至于外界都说楚星河人品好？马良更是嗤之以鼻，人前一套背后一套的人多了去了，这个楚星河肯定是个腹黑的家伙，只不过他隐藏极好没有被人发现罢了。
所以虽然身在百人团里，可是马良始终都是不服气的。
楚星河说不让去看万花盛会，凭什么？老子非要去！
可是马良没想到，自己竟然遇到这种事。
马良虽然后悔，但也没有任何办法，在马良看来，这一下楚星河必定要抓住自己违背他命令的事情狠狠的教训自己，甚至回去以后肯定也要在宗门添油加醋一番，自己也必定要受到惩罚。
但马良已经做好了心理准备，最多就是舍弃这精英弟子的身份不要了呗，以自己的实力，早晚还能拿回来。
可就在马良等待着楚星河斥责的时候，楚星河却直接喊来了十几个师兄弟！
“你们跟我一起去万花楼，老子倒要看看，是那个狗杂种敢动我师弟！
他妈的活腻了是吧！”
楚星河的话不光让马良傻了。
连扶着马良回来的弟子也傻了。
他们是跟马良一起入门的，也是一宫的弟子，平日里就关系极好。
今日马良违规在前，被人偷袭受伤在后，惩罚是肯定少不了的，两人都在思索着怎么帮马良求情了。
可万没想到，星河师兄压根连责怪都没有责怪马良，反而直接点人要去万花楼。
这操作直接让两人愣住了。
“还愣着干什么！
出发！”
楚星河大手一挥，所有人跟上。
一群人浩浩荡荡的来到万花盛会所在的万花楼。
此时万花楼前依旧是人山人海，看得出来刚才发生的事情并没有对这里造成太大的影响。
马良直到来到万花楼前脑子都懵懵的，楚星河这是要干啥？
而就在马良愣神的功夫，楚星河已经带着所有人进入了万花楼。
面对一群杀气腾腾的年轻人，万花楼的人显然也看出来了这不是来选花魁的，更有人认出了马良就是刚才被偷袭的人。
“诸位请留……”
一个看起来像是护卫头领一样的家伙上前想要阻挡，可他话还没有说完，就被楚星河一脚直接踹在胸口，整个人倒飞而出！
万花楼的桌子被倒飞的人砸的一片狼藉，一时间万花楼中一片混乱，无数美貌的花魁们也是花容失色。
不光万花楼这边的人愣了，连跟着楚星河一起来的师弟们都愣了……
星河师兄这么暴躁的吗？
连话都不让人说完就直接动手？
无数护卫从四面八方朝着这边围了上来，楚星河一挥手：“让他们全给我趴下！”
“得令！”
众多师弟这会儿一看星河师兄都动手了，还有什么可犹豫的。
根本不需要任何灵兵，一群昊天宗的天之骄子，还是优中选优，哪怕境界并不高，也绝不是这些小护卫能抵挡的。
十息之后，现场再也没有一个可以站着的护卫。
万花楼的人也傻了，他们见过不讲理的，但是这么不讲理的他们是闻所未闻，你好歹说一下情况再动手吧？
一言不发上来就打人是什么鬼？
“无关人员全部滚出去，不然就跟他们一样趴下！
content_en:
In fact, Ma Liang has never liked Chu Xinghe.
Everyone entered the mountain gate on the same day, why did Chu Xinghe receive all kinds of praise and be held in the highest place?
In Ma Liang's opinion, everything Chu Xinghe did was just luck.
As for the outside world saying that Chu Xinghe has good character? Ma Liang even sneered. There were so many people who acted one way in front of others and another behind the scenes. This Chu Xinghe must be a sinister guy, but he hid it very well without being discovered.
So even though he was in a group of 100 people, Ma Liang was always unconvinced.
Chu Xinghe said he was not allowed to go to the Ten Thousand Flowers Festival. Why? I must go!
But Ma Liang didn't expect that he would encounter such a thing.
Although Ma Liang regretted it, there was nothing he could do. In Ma Liang's view, Chu Xinghe would definitely catch him for violating his orders and teach him a lesson. Even after he returned, he would definitely add fuel to the sect's jealousy, and he would definitely be punished.
But Ma Liang has been mentally prepared. The most he can do is give up his status as an elite disciple. With his own strength, he can get it back sooner or later.
But while Ma Liang was waiting for Chu Xinghe to scold him, Chu Xinghe directly called over a dozen fellow apprentices!
"You guys come with me to Wanhua Tower. I want to see if that bastard dares to touch my junior brother!
Tired of fucking living, aren't you? "
Chu Xinghe's words not only made Ma Liang stupid.
Even the disciple who helped Ma Liang back was dumbfounded.
They started together with Ma Liang, and were also disciples of the first palace. They had a very good relationship on weekdays.
Today, Ma Liang broke the rules first and was attacked and injured later. Punishment is definitely inevitable. Both of them were thinking about how to plead for Ma Liang.
Unexpectedly, Senior Brother Xinghe didn't even blame Ma Liang, but directly ordered people to go to Wanhua Tower.
This operation immediately stunned the two of them.
"What are you still doing?
Let’s go! "
Chu Xinghe waved his hand and everyone followed.
A group of people came to the Wanhua Tower where the Wanhua Festival was held.
At this time, there was still a sea of ​​people in front of Wanhua Tower. It was obvious that what happened just now did not have much impact on the place.
Ma Liang was confused until he arrived at Wanhua Tower. What was Chu Xinghe doing?
While Ma Liang was stunned, Chu Xinghe had already led everyone into Wanhua Tower.
Facing a group of murderous young people, the people in Wanhua Tower obviously realized that they were not here to choose the oiran, and some even recognized Ma Liang as the person who had been attacked just now.
"Everyone, please stay..."
A guy who looked like a guard leader stepped forward to stop him, but before he could finish his words, Chu Xinghe kicked him in the chest and he flew backwards!
"Boom..."
The tables in the Wanhua Building were smashed into a mess by people flying upside down. For a moment, the Wanhua Building was in chaos, and countless beautiful courtesan also lost their beauty.
Not only the people at Wanhua Building were stunned, but also the junior brothers who came with Chu Xinghe were stunned...
Is Senior Brother Xinghe so irritable?
You don't even let anyone finish what you're saying and just start taking action?
Countless guards surrounded us from all directions. Chu Xinghe waved his hand: "Let them all get down!"
"Got the order!"
When all the junior brothers saw that Senior Brother Xinghe had taken action, there was nothing left to hesitate.
There is no need for any spiritual soldiers at all. A group of Haotian Sect's proud sons are still selected from the best. Even if their realm is not high, they are definitely not something that these little guards can resist.
After ten breaths, there was no longer a standing guard at the scene.
The people in Wanhualou are also stupid. They have seen unreasonable people, but they have never heard of such unreasonable people. Why don't you explain the situation before taking action?
What's the point of hitting someone without even saying a word?
"All irrelevant personnel should get out or lie down like them!
title_en: Chapter 23: The irritable Senior Brother Chu Chapter 24: Dream to become an outstanding person like Senior Brother Xinghe
